AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: Computer Science Engineer specialized in Full Stack development and Artificial Intelligence. Passionate about creating technological solutions that optimize business processes and provide real added value.
My expertise covers web and mobile application development, AI model integration for object detection (YOLOv8, Computer Vision), and implementation of robust and scalable microservices architectures.
I am committed to writing clean, maintainable and scalable code by applying best development practices and appropriate design patterns.
